verdict.rationale: Ashby ships its own authenticated API, with endpoints for creating candidates, listing applications with sync tokens, job postings, and webhooks. Its official MCP server exposes search and retrieval across a broad set of recruiting records. No evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, so coverage of the story's parity claim is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement or full endpoint coverage map, evidence of write/admin coverage (e.g., scheduling, offers, settings, reports via API), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A sync token to retrieve only applications updated since the last sync.
Use HTTP Basic Auth to authenticate with our API. You must send your API key with every request.
Search and retrieve recruiting context across candidates, applications, jobs, job postings, interviews, offers, notes, feedback, emails, referrals, hiring teams, and other recruiting records.
